visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Gap Before the Second Word
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Joining Code and Varsity should print CodeVarsity, but the program prints only Code.

solution.explanation: Writing one position too far leaves the original terminating '\0' of Code in place, so the string still ends right after Code and the new text is never seen by printf. The copy must start exactly at the old terminator.
